behavior: Each RPC role keeps a host that works: Arc's working hosts go to different roles, and a host refusing us rests at once
acceptance: packages/contracts/chains.json lists Arc testnet's public RPCs dRPC, rpc.testnet.arc.io, QuickNode, Blockdaemon: with Infura keys the second role is dRPC and QuickNode, and Blockdaemon (Brotli to Go everywhere) is primary beside Infura (D-15); the Arc canary in .env.example uses dRPC and QuickNode instead of Blockdaemon

An endpoint that answers HTTP 401, 403 or 404, or an answer that is not JSON-RPC, rests RestMax at once instead of RestBase, since that doesn't heal in seconds; timeouts, 429 and 5xx keep the growing rest
docs/backend/architecture.md says the list order decides the roles, each role needs a host that answers, and that from regions Cloudflare blocks Arc needs Infura keys
notes: 2026-10-22 review fail by reviewer: Code is right: roles stay host-disjoint with and without Infura keys; only 401/403/404 and non-JSON answers rest 5 min (check, call and batch all go through post); no key reaches errors or logs; the new test fails on main's pool.go and passes with -race. 'dRPC serves the second role and Infura the primary' holds only with INFURA_API_KEYS: without keys the second role is rpc.testnet.arc.io + QuickNode, which refuse from here, so Arc can't start keyless, against the paragraph's 'so it runs without Infura keys'; '(the chain's own RPC, then publicnode or dRPC)' no longer fits Arc.
